dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Another commission asking for me by name? Nuh-uh, not taking it. Send it back where it came from.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: If they want to talk business, they can drop by my shop in person. I don't discuss work via letter.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh... Can you really send a commission back the way it came?

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: *sigh* You have no idea how tedious business correspondence is.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: A dozen or more letters could bounce back and forth before you could change the dimensions of a single component.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: I've wasted more time delivering letters than I care to tally up.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Anyone who's got that much time can come to the tribe and talk with me face to face. It's more efficient that way.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: ...Huh? Another letter? And they insist I open it? Seriously...

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: It's Mavuika. She's already at my workshop. Waiting to discuss things with me "face to face."

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Nope. Not gonna happen. I gotta get away, far, far away... Think, Xilonen, think...

choices.text: Is it a particularly troublesome client?
